meta.title: Responses tab shows round details including End Price
gaps: Verify the displayed offer amount, End Price, tick size, and time difference match the configured Dutch auction values because those expected values are not provided and no API-value assertion covers these round-detail fields.
Guarantee that open_event selects the published Dutch auction when no event title or id is supplied.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the displayed offer amount, End Price, tick size, and time difference match the configured Dutch auction values because those expected values are not provided and no API-value assertion covers these round-detail fields.; Guarantee that open_event selects the published Dutch auction when no event title or id is supplied.

steps.note: Open the existing published event described by the setup.
Navigate to the event's Responses tab, which is the subject of the test.
Assert that the Responses tab displays the End Price detail.
Assert that the round details include tick size.
Assert that the round details include time difference.
Assert that upcoming offers are shown.
Assert that the bidder list section is visible.
